user.title: AI-Sähkövahti — License & Price Area
user.description: Enter your personal license key (Pro / VIP) or free 24h trial key. Next, the guided Yes/No wizard helps you configure temperature sensors, water heater, floor heating, EVs, and heat pumps without YAML coding.

data.area: Price area (e.g. FI, SE3, NO1, DE)
data.source_entity_id: Custom Home Assistant price sensor (optional for FI)

wiz_sensors_yn.title: Step 1/5 — Electricity Tariff & Temperature Sensors
wiz_sensors_yn.description: Select your electricity contract type (day/night tariff also supported) and answer Yes/No whether you have temperature sensors upstairs, downstairs, or outdoors. You can also answer No to all.

data.has_upstairs_sensor: Do you have an upstairs temperature sensor?
data.has_downstairs_sensor: Do you have a downstairs temperature sensor?
data.has_outdoor_sensor: Do you have an outdoor temperature sensor?

wiz_sensors_details.title: Step 1/5 — Select Sensors or Enter WiFi Sensor Name
wiz_sensors_details.description: Select one or more Home Assistant sensors from the list AND/OR enter the WiFi sensor name (e.g. Shelly H&T Upstairs, RuuviTag Downstairs).

wiz_water_yn.title: Step 2/5 — Domestic Hot Water Heater
wiz_water_yn.description: Do you have an electric water heater? Note: Home Assistant cannot switch 230/400 V power without a smart relay or contactor — if your heater has no WiFi control yet, AI-Sähkövahti still reserves its load for fuse protection and provides a setup recommendation.

data.has_water_heater: Do you have a domestic hot water heater?

wiz_water_details.title: Step 2/5 — Water Heater Details
wiz_water_details.description: Enter the heater name and power (kW). If the heater or its contactor does not yet have a WiFi relay (e.g. Shelly Pro 1PM), select 'No' for WiFi/HA connection.

data.name: Water heater name
data.has_wifi_or_ha: Is the heater or its contactor connected to WiFi / HA?

wiz_floor_yn.title: Step 3/5 — Electric Floor Heating
wiz_floor_yn.description: Do you have electric floor heating? If Yes, you can configure one or multiple rooms along with concrete slab and surface temperature sensors.

data.has_floor_heating: Do you have electric floor heating?
data.floor_scope: Is floor heating in a single room or multiple rooms?

wiz_floor_room.title: Step 3/5 — Floor Heating Room Details
wiz_floor_room.description: A concrete slab sensor enables heat-storing preheating during the cheapest night hours; a surface-only sensor uses shorter, steady heating cycles so the floor surface does not cool down too much.

data.room_name: Room or zone name (e.g. Bathroom, Downstairs)
data.has_wifi_or_ha: Is the room thermostat/relay connected to WiFi / HA?
data.has_concrete_sensor: Does this room have a concrete slab sensor?
data.has_surface_sensor: Does this room have a surface / room air sensor?

wiz_ev_yn.title: Step 4/5 — Electric Vehicle or Charger
wiz_ev_yn.description: Do you have an electric vehicle or EV charger? You can add one or multiple vehicles and swap a vehicle later with one click without breaking automations.

data.has_ev: Do you have an electric vehicle or EV charger?

wiz_ev_details.title: Step 4/5 — EV / Charger Details
wiz_ev_details.description: Connect an HA control entity (e.g. Tesla, Easee, Zaptec) or add the vehicle as a manual load without network connection.

data.name: Vehicle or charger name
data.has_wifi_or_ha: Is the vehicle or charger connected to WiFi / HA?

wiz_other_yn.title: Step 5/5 — Heat Pumps, Electric Radiators & Sauna
wiz_other_yn.description: Would you like to add air-to-water/air-source heat pumps (e.g. Mitsubishi, NIBE), upstairs/downstairs electric radiators, or a sauna stove?

data.has_other_device: Add a heat pump, electric radiators, or sauna?

wiz_other_details.title: Step 5/5 — Add Heating Device or Load
wiz_other_details.description: You can add multiple devices in a row by selecting 'Yes' at the bottom.

data.name: Device or room name
data.has_wifi_or_ha: Is the device connected to WiFi / HA?
